title: pauseWithdraw silently forfeits accrued rewards (no event, no debt rebase) and the orphaned reward share lingers in the accumulator with no on-chain redistribution semantics
rootCause: `pauseWithdraw` reduces `user.amount` and `totalStaked` but does NOT call `_updatePool`/`_claimRewards` and does NOT rebase `user.{phUSD,stable}Debt`. Three layered effects: (a) exiter's accrued rewards are silently forfeited with no dedicated event beyond generic `EmergencyWithdrawal`; (b) the user's `userInfo[u].XDebt` becomes orphaned vs the new `user.amount`, causing DEDUP-002/DEDUP-003 reverts on subsequent claim/view paths; (c) the per-share accumulators already credited the exiter's share but no redistribution semantics exist, so the value either lingers as dead-weight in `rewardBalance` or implicitly enriches future entrants in unpredictable ways.
impactSummary: User-visible loss of accrued rewards each pauseWithdraw cycle, beyond the 'emergency exit' phrasing. No telemetry for off-chain reconciliation. The 'forfeit' framing is incomplete — the actual behavior is value-leakage with no defined redistribution.
preservedDetails: CODE-009 carries the implementation-level framing (no event, no debt rebase, profile §4.3 spec-vs-behavior gap). ECON-011 carries the economic redistribution analysis (orphaned headroom in accumulators, extractive variant by future entrants).
remediation: Either (a) call `_updatePool` + `_claimRewards` inside `pauseWithdraw` before the principal cut; (b) proportionally rebase debts so the user still claims the rewards earned on the un-withdrawn share; (c) emit a `RewardsForfeited(user, phUSDForfeit, stableForfeit)` event and decrement `rewardBalance` accordingly to return the forfeited share to the funder pool. Option (a) or (b) also fixes DEDUP-002 / DEDUP-003.
consolidationRationale: Same root cause (no debt rebase in pauseWithdraw) and same one-line remediation. CODE-009 is the 'spec deviation / no event' angle; ECON-011 is the 'orphaned reward-share redistribution semantics' angle. Both are downstream of the same un-rebased-debt defect.
dedupNotes: DEDUP-002 (mutating-path DoS) and DEDUP-003 (view DoS) are also downstream of the un-rebased pauseWithdraw, but the impact is different (revert vs silent loss). Kept as three separate findings because severity hints diverge (High / Medium / Medium) and remediation pathway is shared but stakeholders differ.
